name: Sawamura Asato
source:
An aspiring novel writer, generally a caring boyfriend but he can immerse himself too much in work and end up neglecting Akane sometimes, paving the way for other men to approach her.

[spoiler] The particular trait of his character that separates him from the usual protagonist for a Netorare Eroge is that Asato can turn into an extremely violent individual if pushed far enough; resorting to murder in many cases. [/spoiler]
